title: Wellbeing survey
introBody: These are 10 short questions about the last 7 days. About 2 minutes. It's a screening, not a diagnosis: the result never says what's wrong — only whether talking to a specialist may help.
resultLowBody: Your result doesn't point to elevated risk. Come back from time to time — it's worth it.
resultModerate: Worth caring for yourself more closely
resultModerateBody: Your result suggests talking to a specialist or more frequent support may help. Retake the survey in 2 weeks.
resultHigh: Your result suggests talking to a specialist may help
resultHighBody: You don't have to stay alone with this. You'll find concrete steps below.
resultUrgentBody: Your answers suggest reaching out for help now. That's a good, brave step.
retakeInfo: We repeat the survey every 14 days.
dueBody: It's been 2 weeks since the last one. Two minutes — for peace of mind.
